name.description: The short friendly name of the agent

description.description: The long description of the agent

uid.description: The unique ID reported by the server

last_heartbeat_on.description: The last time (rfc3339 timestamp) a heartbeat was received from this agent

uptime_seconds.description: How long since the last reboot of this server. Recorded in DB at the time of the last heartbeat

hostname.description: The hostname reported from the host itself

public_ip.description: The public IP address of the server

ip_tables_saved.description: The agent was able to save IP tables

os_detail.description: Additional OS details - just displayed to end user

log_traffic.description: True if we want to log traffic events from this agent

target_pce_fqdn.description: The FQDN of the PCE the agent will use for future connections

active_pce_fqdn.description: The FQDN of the PCE that received the agent's last heartbeat

ven.description: The href under the VENs resource that points to this agent. The agents API is deprecated, and the VEN href should be used to identify and manipulate this resource.
